name: Snare drum
summary: Single snare drum on a stand with two drumsticks crossed above the head; anim hit strikes the drum.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stand feet rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 460 px wide and 640 px tall (a drum on a stand is about 0.35 m tall as a shell)

params.name: anim
params.note: hit = the sticks strike the head in turn and the head flexes

author: krakujs
